A '''"Dumb" Energy Quarrel''' was a type of explosive ammunition that was designed to cause energy damage upon impact. The [[Quarrel/Legends|quarrels]] were usable in the [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]]. "Dumb" Energy Quarrels were produced by [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] as a type of ammunition that could be used in the MM9 rocket system, a model of [[wrist rocket launcher]] that was also produced by Kelvarek. <ref name="AEG" /> The quarrels lacked a targeting system, and in the MM9 system, they were used in tandem alongside other types of rockets that used homing systems.<ref name="weapons">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The quarrels were widely available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the price of fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each, although the sale and ownership of the ammunition was restricted to individuals with the appropriate license and government approval.<ref name="AEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Dumb" Energy Quarrel were mentioned in the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', a [[2002]] sourcebook written by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AEG" />
